user_query: My company is planning a team-building event at a remote location, and we need to calculate the total cost of the event. Evaluate the expression '($150 * 20) + ($50 * 15) + ($100 * 10)' to find the total cost. Additionally, analyze the working days between January 1st and December 31st in the US, considering the federal holidays. Also, define a custom period for the event from September 1st to September 5th.

TaskList.description: Calculate the total cost of the event based on the given expression.
Evaluate the number of federal holidays within the year 2023 in the US.
Calculate the total number of working days in the US from January 1st to December 31st considering federal holidays.
Define the custom period for the team-building event from September 1st to September 5th.
